invariants: Every new or changed English string gets a Welsh draft beside it in the same change, as the service's other copy does.

Every changed page works fully without JavaScript: every state change is a form post, every search and filter a form with a button that submits it, and JavaScript only enhances a page that already works (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 6; conflicts:c-006).

A behaviour is built with GOV.UK Frontend first, then another tested government library (Ministry of Justice, HMRC, Scottish Government); no custom JavaScript is written to copy the prototype, pop-ups are not built and confirmations stay pages (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claims 5, 7 and 19).
Pages are built from GOV.UK Frontend components and govuk-* classes; the prototype's custom app-dr2-* blocks are not copied.

A search box is the real frontend's accessible autocomplete over a native select and behaves as the real frontend configures it; its entries are what MDM serves through reference-data, and only how the list reads follows the prototype (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claims 1 to 4).

Where a row changes a page or behaviour the high-risk plants frontend also has, the same increment changes plants too: plants mirrors the structure, wording patterns, components and behaviour, and keeps its own questions, data and step order (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claims 43 and 44).
Shared wording in a frontend's shared copy is never reworded in place; a set-specific string goes in the feature's own copy (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 41).

Notification statuses are only ever added, never renamed or removed, and each new status is mapped in every frontend that reads it before the animals backend first sends it (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 42).
A page in its error state keeps the 'Error: ' prefix on its browser title (conflicts:c-006).
'Save and return to overview' makes exactly the same checks as 'Save and continue' (ruling:sam-2026-10-26 claim 1; conflicts:c-341, which replaced c-211).
Notifications, templates and address book entries stay scoped to the signed-in user's organisation (or user, for templates); nothing lists another organisation's records.
Each increment updates the tests repo's specs, page objects and journey helpers its change breaks, in the same change.

increments.title: The theme branch takes in what main has landed since it was cut
increments.detail: The branch was cut on 13 October, stacked on the journey foundation and reference lists branches, and last took main that day. Since then main has landed journey foundation and reference lists in their reviewed form, design snagging (EUDPA-720, 23 October), which reworked arrival details and the transit countries page and took this theme's arrival wording, port labels and transit Back link, and the 26 October Save and return ruling (animals frontend #436). The branch is now 26 commits behind main in the animals frontend, 30 in the plants frontend and 167 in the tests repo, and every one of its pull requests conflicts with main, so GitHub runs no checks on them. A trial merge conflicts in 16 animals frontend files (port-of-entry and transit-countries controllers, templates, validators, copy and tests, check-answers copy and tests, arrival-transit.fit.spec.js, shared/kit.js, services/countries/index.js, accessible-autocomplete.js), 6 plants frontend files (arrival-details copy, template, fit spec and shared/kit.js) and 17 tests repo files (the animals and plants arrival details page objects, the transited countries page object, flows/animals/journey.ts, resources/reference-data/reference-data.ts and the arrival, transit, soft-save, reference-list, hub and journey specs). Each conflict sets main's rewrite against an older copy of the same work: everything the branch carried is either on main in a newer form or belongs to a todo row of this theme (inc-241, inc-029, inc-174), which rebuilds it on main's code.
acceptanceCriteria: origin/main is merged into feat/EUDPA-694-design-release-2-1-arrival-and-transit in the animals frontend, the plants frontend and the tests repo, as one two-parent merge commit each, with no conflict markers left in any file.

After the merge each repo's tree is identical to origin/main: git diff origin/main HEAD prints nothing. In every conflicting file, and in every file the merge applied cleanly, main's version wins, because the branch's hunks are older copies of work main now holds or work inc-241, inc-029 and inc-174 rebuild.
Animals frontend #402, plants frontend #95 and tests #24 each report no conflict with their base, so GitHub runs their checks again.
Every one of those pull requests is green.
notes: Added 2 November by the re-analysis (reanalysis.md beside this backlog), under Sam's ruling of 2 November that the stale branch is reused, with main brought in, rather than replaced by a fresh one.

The branch's own commits stay in its history for the later rows to take code from: animals frontend 843821b8 (required means), 49e22db9 (transit title and redirect) and 7d42a714 (transit country list); tests 5246f57, 29c74b5, 22a54fa and bf126b6. Nothing from them survives this merge.

The stub (#20), reference data (#27) and INS frontend (#49) branches are not merged: they carry only journey foundation and reference lists work that main already holds (a trial merge of main is clean and leaves each tree identical to main), no row builds in them, and none of them has a branch image, so the pull requests' end-to-end runs use main's :latest image for those services.

gatePhases is [] because the baseline would run on the 13 October tree, which is not what the merge leaves. The pull requests prove the merged tree, and the next row's baseline runs unit and FIT on it.

Finished outside the loop on 3 November, with Sam's go. The 2 November run stopped ci-red: the stack took 13 October branch images for reference data, stub and INS frontend, whose reference data had no commodity search. Main was merged into those three theme branches (5976c37, 12a4c2a, 625ca19) and their images rebuilt. The review edits the run made to main's arrival and transit code were put back to main's version (animals ed1cb76c, plants d208d05, tests 2d3b4a0), at Sam's choice. Tests now equals main; both frontends equal main plus the joi and @hapi/content upgrade the security audit needs. #402, #95 and #24 all green.
openQuestions: The judge made ten code-quality fixes to files the merge takes from origin/main (animals frontend port-of-entry and transit-countries, task-rows.test.js, commercial-transporter-details.fit.spec.js; plants frontend arrival-details controller, copy and controller.test.js; tests transited-countries.spec.ts and plants arrival.spec.ts). House rules make every code-quality finding fix-now, so they land as one follow-up commit per repo after the pure merge commit. The merge commit itself still equals origin/main, but HEAD then differs from origin/main by those fixes, so the criterion that git diff origin/main HEAD prints nothing holds at the merge commit, not at HEAD. Should the criterion read that way, or should these fixes go to main in their own PR instead?

increments.title: Arrival details requires a means of transport, on both save buttons
